messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — we need to lock the Snowflake + Databricks connector marketplace launch cadence. Can product and eng confirm target week?

michael: aiming for week of Apr 25th. Engineering can commit to feature-complete by Apr 4th for marketplace packaging.

lucas: timeline sounds ok but we need vector DB compatibility testing (Qdrant + Milvus). Can SIs run a week-long soak starting Apr 8?

sara: we can do SI soak Apr 8–12. Need a clear test matrix + sample dataset. @michael please share test scripts and expected result templates.

michael: putting scripts in the partner repo: https://git.redwood/partners/connector-tests — will add README and runbook.

michael: test matrix draft: indexing correctness, query-latency p50/p95, ingest-throughput, concurrency, multi-tenant isolation, schema-evolution, and serialization/roundtrip checks.

partners-bot: Reminder: Legal review required for marketplace listing. Deadline Apr 10.

anya: Legal + Security — can you confirm docs for data handling and redaction? @joseph? Need to surface this for marketplace listing checklist.

joseph: Security ✅ but request: include KMS integration plan for Private deployments and an explicit network diagram showing ingress/egress. I can draft that. ETA Apr 7.

lucas: packaging question: single OCI bundle vs multiple artifacts? Recommend OCI bundle for cloud marketplace and easier HW partner (DGX) preloads. Ops/eng objections?

sara: OCI bundle preferred from GTM and field enablement POV. Makes SW distribution to partners simpler.

anya: Action items (owners + rough dates):
1) michael - add test scripts + matrix to repo (by Apr 1)
2) joseph - KMS + network doc + appendix on data redaction (by Apr 7)
3) product - finalize marketplace listing copy, SKUs & pricing (by Apr 10)
4) partnerships - draft joint announcement timeline + embargo window + OEM mentions (by Apr 12)

michael: noted. Also flag: Databricks runtime incompatibility observed on 8.2 for our connector v0.9 — planning patch on Apr 3. That patch will be required for approved marketplace image.

partners-bot: Calendar invite sent: 'Partner Launch Orchestration — Apr 15' with stakeholders from Eng/Product/Legal/SI.

anya: We should also lock the joint blog + webinar date now. Proposal: blog Apr 25, webinar May 2. Thoughts?

lucas: Works for me. Field enablement needs sample notebooks for Snowflake, Databricks, and a Qdrant quickstart. I'll start drafting notebooks this week.

sara: SI acceptance criteria: run 3 POCs with sample data across client stacks and submit metric reports (latency, success rate, ingest RPS). We'll add that to the SI checklist.

michael: I'll tag PRs and ping reviewers when tests land. Expect initial CI runs by Mar 29.

anya: Great. Please post any blockers in this thread. We'll review progress in the Apr 15 orchestration call. :thumbsup:

lucas: one last ask — hardware partners: DGX team asked for an early image to preload NVLink settings. Can partnerships coordinate the artifact handoff (OCI image + SHA) by Apr 10?

sara: adding handoff to partnership todo. We'll coordinate credentials and an embargoed S3 bucket.

anya: Closed-loop: everyone who owns an action, drop a short status update here by EOD next Thursday. Thanks all!
